1742-1978-3363-3789.notablePrerequisites: The One Ring has a burden counter on it and does not have summoning sickness.
1742-1978-3363-3789.description:
Animate The One Ring using The Blackstaff of Waterdeep.
Activate The One Ring by tapping it, putting a burden counter on it and drawing a card for each burden counter on it.
Activate Skirge Familiar twice by discarding two cards, adding {B}{B}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping The One Ring.
Repeat from step 2.

3469-5261-7280.easyPrerequisites:
Energy Arc is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Isochron Scepter doesn't have summoning sickness.
3469-5261-7280.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
3469-5261-7280.description:
Animate Isochron Scepter using Donatello.
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Energy Arc without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Energy Arc, untapping all creatures you control
Repeat from step 2.

662-1978-8190.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures with different powers.
662-1978-8190.description:
Cause Loot to become an artifact using Liquimetal Coating.
Activate Loot by tapping it, adding at least {3}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Loot.
Repeat from step 2.

2187-5478-5531-5694-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
2187-5478-5531-5694-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Possessed Skaab and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Possessed Skaab and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
Resolve the Possessed Skaab trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
Repeat.
2187-5478-5531-5694-8110.notes:
If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Possessed Skaab and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.
An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

1429-5958-6495.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1429-5958-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Curator Beastie.
Resolve the Evereth ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.
1429-5958-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

2279-2558-8095--109.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a 2/2 creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
2279-2558-8095--109.description:
Cause a 2/2 creature to enter the battlefield under your control, which enters as a 1/1.
Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the 1/1 creature.
Quintorius triggers. Holding priority, activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Quintorius trigger, creating a 2/2 creature token.
Repeat from step 2.

728-7084-7893.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Thranduil triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

3532-5078-7693-7742.easyPrerequisites:
There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
Armor Wars' second chapter ability has resolved this turn.
3532-5078-7693-7742.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Machinesmith Automaton triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Machinesmith Automaton.
Repeat.

2103-4125-5144.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ephemerate by paying {W}, blinking Shipwreck Dowser and exiling Ephemerate.
When Shipwreck Dowser enters, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Ephemerate's rebound ability triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Ephemerate, blinking Shipwreck Dowser.
When Shipwreck Dowser enters, it triggers, returning Ephemerate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2539-3094-4659-7297-7344.easyPrerequisites: You have an artifact card in your graveyard.
2539-3094-4659-7297-7344.description:
Cast Brilliance Unleashed by paying {4}{U}{R}. Choose its second mode, targeting any artifact card in your graveyard.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's second ability by paying {3} and tapping it, targeting Brilliance Unleashed.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Lithoform Engine, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Lithoform Engine ability, copying Brilliance Unleashed twice due to Twinning Staff, targeting Lithoform Engine and another artifact card in your graveyard.
Resolve both copies of Brilliance Unleashed, returning Lithoform Engine and the other artifact from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the other artifact, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

5075-5147-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
5075-5147-7084.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Ogre Slumlord and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Ogre Slumlord trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

2131-5660-7178.notablePrerequisites:
You have a creature or artifact card in your graveyard.
You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
2131-5660-7178.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning an artifact or creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Thran Vigil triggers. Holding priority, activate Iron-Shield Elf by discarding an artifact or creature card.
Resolve the Thran Vigil ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Grub, Storied Matriarch // Grub, Notorious Auntie

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-7196.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature that has haste and that has toughness 2 or greater.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-7196.description:
Declare Grub and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers. Grub triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on the creature with haste, and then creating a tapped and attacking copy of that creature.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.  Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the token with haste, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Move to your next combat phase, and declare Grub and the token that has Breath of Fury attached as attackers.
Grub triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on the creature with Breath of Fury attached, and then creating a tapped and attacking copy of that creature.
Repeat from step 2.

3000-4017-4050-5086-5183.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
3000-4017-4050-5086-5183.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Triskelavus triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding one mana of any color
Repeat from step 1.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

1939-3490-4017-4050.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1939-3490-4017-4050.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Lunarch Veteran triggers if it's on the battlefield.
Regardless, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}
When the Servo dies, Luminous Phantom triggers if it's on the battlefield.
Resolve either the Lunarch Veteran or Luminous Phantom trigger, causing you to gain life
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Sunbond attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

3375-3532-3949-5078.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3375-3532-3949-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Kappa Cannoneer triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Kappa Cannoneer.
Repeat.

1170-1482-1492-6862.easyPrerequisites: One of the artifacts must be in your hand, while the other is either in your graveyard or in your library.
1170-1482-1492-6862.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one additional artifact on the battlefield.
1170-1482-1492-6862.description:
Cast the artifact in your hand by paying its mana cost.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Delivery Moogle.
When Delivery Moogle enters, it triggers, searching your library or graveyard for the other artifact and putting it into your hand.
Activate the artifact cast in step 1 by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

413-4484-4871-5643-6556.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
413-4484-4871-5643-6556.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures with power 4 or greater.
413-4484-4871-5643-6556.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Blasting Station and Geralf's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Geralf trigger,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Zombie Rogue.
When the Zombie Rogue dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Resolve the Ebondeath spell. When Ebondeath enters, Blasting Station and Geralf's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Geralf trigger, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Ebondeath.
When Ebondeath dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
413-4484-4871-5643-6556.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

1339-4050-4063-6625.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Fleshtaker triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and scry 1.
Matoya triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent

568-1267-3613.description:
Deal combat damage using Medomai, triggering its ability, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
During your extra turn, cast Dress Down by paying {1}{U}. When it enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Declare Medomai as an attacker, as it does not have its restriction due to Dress Down.
Holding priority, cast Capsize with buyback by paying {4}{U}{U}, returning Dress Down and Capsize to your hand.
Repeat from step 1.

985-5043-5078-5231.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Alela triggers, creating a 1/1 Faerie creature token.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Faerie, adding {R}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Repeat.

4200-5917-6441.notablePrerequisites: You control a permanent that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {1}.
4200-5917-6441.description:
Activate a permanent you control by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate The Jolly Balloon Man by paying {1} and tapping it, creating two token copies of Icewind Stalwart that are 1/1 Balloons with haste.
When the Icewind Stalwart tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, blinking the mana-producing permanent and The Jolly Balloon Man.
Repeat.

requires.n: Permanent with "You don't lose the game due to having 0 or less life"

2656-3859--84.description:
Activate Cavern Harpy by paying 1 life.
Repeat step 1 until you have 0 life.
Resolve all Cavern Harpy abilities.
Cast Repay in Kind by paying {5}{B}{B}, causing each opponent's life total to become 0.
Each opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having 0 life.

826-3899-4730-6243.notablePrerequisites: Amoeboid Changeling does not have summoning sickness.
826-3899-4730-6243.description:
Activate Amoeboid Changeling's second ability by tapping it, removing all creature types from Sparring Mummy.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Sparring Mummy.
When Sparring Mummy dies, Valkyrie's Call triggers, returning Sparring Mummy from your graveyard to the battlefield as an Angel with flying and a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Sparring Mummy enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Amoeboid Changeling.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on it.
Repeat.

880-2907-5478.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
880-2907-5478.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
When the land enters the battlefield, each Scute Swarm you control triggers, creating that many creature token(s).
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

511-817-1308-1887-4050.description:
Activate Fungal Bloom by paying {G}{G}, putting two spore counters on a Fungus you control.
Activate a Fungus by removing two spore counters from it, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing two Saprolings, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

1429-2981-5958.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1429-2981-5958.description:
Activate Megatog by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Curator Beastie.
Resolve the Megatog ability, giving it +3/+3 until end of turn.
Repeat.

328-338-4013-5296.notablePrerequisites:
Light of Promise attached to Workhorse.
Your devotion to black is at least three, or you have at least two opponents.
328-338-4013-5296.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Gray Merchant of Asphodel.
When Gray Merchant of Asphodel enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to your devotion to black, and causing you to gain that much life.
Workhorse triggers, putting at least three +1/+1 counters on itself.
Activate Workhorse three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
If your devotion to black is at least four, or you have at least two opponents, this combo nets infinite +1/+1 counters on Workhorse and colorless mana.

628-2034-2493-2596-3944.notablePrerequisites: Blood Pet does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
628-2034-2493-2596-3944.description:
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it, adding {B}.
When Blood Pet dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it to the battlefield from your graveyard with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing Archaeomancer and Mikaeus, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Living Death by paying {3}{B}{B}, causing each player to exile all creature cards in their graveyards, sacrifice all creatures they control, then put all cards exiled this way onto the battlefield.
When Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Living Death to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.

1864-3129-4050.manaNeeded: {3}{B}{R}{G} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
1864-3129-4050.description:
Cast Prossh from the command zone by paying {3}{B}{R}{G} and commander tax, if applicable.
Prossh triggers, creating a number of 0/1 Kobolds of Kher Keep creature tokens equal to twice the amount of mana spent to cast Prossh.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing Prossh and two Kobolds, adding {B}{R}{G}.
Choose to return Prossh to the command zone from your graveyard.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Kobold, adding {1}.
Repeat step 5 until you have enough mana to cast Prossh.
Repeat from step 1.

3617-3742-4477.notablePrerequisites: An opponent can not block Phantom Steed.
3617-3742-4477.description:
Cast Time Walk, taking an extra turn after this one.
Attack with Phantom Steed.
Phantom Steed triggers, creating a token copy of Greenwarden of Murasa that is tapped and attacking.
Greenwarden of Murasa enters, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Pass the turn.
Repeat.

339-677-876-4050.notablePrerequisites: Lightning Greaves is attached to Jegantha.
339-677-876-4050.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar sacrificing Jegantha, adding one mana of any color.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, casting Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Jegantha.
Repeat.
